title: IgA nephropathy predicted effector genes (Kiryluk K et al. 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association analyses define pathogenic signaling pathways and prioritize drug targets for IgA nephropathy.
Kiryluk K, Sanchez-Rodriguez E, Zhou X-J, et al.
Nat Genet. 2023 Jul;55(7):1091-1105. doi: 10.1038/s41588-023-01422-x.
PMID: 37337107

The authors performed a GWAS of IgA nephropathy (IgAN) in 10,146 kidney-biopsy-diagnosed IgAN cases and 28,751 controls, then integrated 13 evidence types to prioritize potential effector genes at each locus. The table below displays scores and evidence for genes supported by at least 3 evidence types. The Priority score indicates the number of evidence types supporting the prediction. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
